summary: Partnerize argues the click was only ever a bridge and AI is changing how affiliate value is counted.
CJ says products only show up in ChatGPT shopping answers if their product data is complete.

Book retailers (Books-A-Million, Apple Books) went big on the ACOTAR 6 launch.

items.title: Partnerize: 'The click was never the value. It was the bridge.' (AI and affiliate field guide)
items.why: A big affiliate network is saying out loud that AI shopping weakens the click as the unit of credit. That's a signal the way affiliate sales get tracked and paid may shift.

items.title: CJ: product data decides which brands appear in ChatGPT shopping answers
items.why: Networks are now coaching brands to get picked by AI shopping answers, another sign that AI assistants are becoming a shopping front door.
